items.title: a safer password vault
items.body: your vault now has its own random key, unlocked by your master password through argon2id, and the server never keeps the password. it locks after 10 idle minutes, clears copied passwords after 90 seconds, slows down wrong guesses, and asks for your current password before a password change or an export. vault settings has an encrypted export with import, and an activity list. your existing vault upgrades itself the next time you unlock it.

items.title: one folder for your stuff
items.body: docs and files now live together in ~/Alles, with docs in ~/Alles/Docs, so files shows everything you wrote. backups moved out of view, next to the data. an older install moves over when you accept the update, or with alles folders move.

items.title: tasks with a time
items.body: give a task a time as well as a day. it goes overdue at that time, and typing 'chem test tomorrow 9am' sets both.

items.title: quick things stay with aide
items.body: adding a task, an event, a habit log or a note line happens right in aide. pi keeps code and longer jobs, and says plainly when it can't finish.

items.title: aide starts from your day
items.body: the empty screen offers your overdue tasks, your next event and habits you haven't logged. with no model set, 'add study for chem to my todo' can still be kept as a task.

items.title: gym sets by text
items.body: tell aide '70x10' or 'left 60x12 right 70x10' between sets and it logs the set in your workout habit right away, with your words kept. pounds and 10 reps unless you say otherwise, 'next 85' is planned, and a side said twice gets one quick question.

items.title: one password box
items.body: full access asks for your password when you switch it on, and the same box shows up anywhere else alles needs it. a message in full access no longer dies with an error.

items.title: typing and read on your phone
items.body: a text you send aide over imessage turns read as soon as it arrives, and the typing bubble stays up while aide works. telegram and discord keep their typing up the same way. a setting turns read receipts off.

items.title: plaid keys checked when you save
items.body: alles checks your plaid keys right away, trims stray spaces, switches to the right plaid setup when the keys belong to the other one, and shows plaid's own message when they don't work.

items.title: updates that explain themselves
items.body: a new release now prepares its own update. status names each release by its short commit, a failed update shows the real error and where its log is, and a release that failed isn't called ready.

items.title: aide in the terminal
items.body: alles ask answers one question right in the terminal and alles chat keeps a whole conversation. both land in aide's history like any other chat.

items.title: a terminal that tells you more
items.body: alles logs filters by level, time and a word, alles backup writes the same encrypted backup as the backup page, and alles dump prints a summary for a bug report with no secrets in it.

items.title: aide's tools on linux
items.body: alles install adds node, and alles tools says what a bare linux box is missing, with the command that fixes it.

items.title: your vault in chrome
items.body: the alles extension now fills cards and addresses as well as logins. get it from passwords, settings, connected browsers: that copy already knows your alles, so you just click connect and approve it there. everything it gets is encrypted to a key only that browser holds. a browser you connected before asks to connect again once.

items.title: andromeda as your search
items.body: chrome and firefox can now add andromeda as a search engine straight from alles, and the extension makes it chrome's default (chrome asks you to keep it). type al and a space in the address bar to search andromeda from any copy of the extension.

items.title: sidebars you can resize
items.body: drag the edge of a sidebar in aide, docs, files, mail, calendar, photos or settings to make it wider or narrower, and it keeps that width. arrow keys work too, and a double click puts it back.

items.title: photo size steps
items.body: the - and + in photos, a pinch, or ctrl and scroll change the picture size in 4 steps. rows keep each picture's shape, and the size is remembered.

items.title: andromeda answers continue in aide
items.body: an andromeda answer ends with continue in aide, which takes the question, the answer and its sources into aide, instead of a box for another question.

items.title: errors stay until you close them
items.body: an error stays on screen with a close button until you close it, so you can read it. confirmations still go away on their own.

items.title: every habit logs its own details
items.body: open a habit and log its day with its own fields: distance and time for a run, glasses for water, care and moisture for plants. today starts from your last entry, so the same as last time is one tap. a gym day shows every session with its note, and an imported workout log reads drop sets, slash sets and failed sets right.

items.title: settings grouped by what you're doing
items.body: models, personas and voice now sit together under how aide answers, and memory, web search and personal records under what aide knows. the server has its own entry. don't like it? general, settings layout switches to by how often, by what it changes, or the classic order.

items.title: access policy in one tap
items.body: server, access policy no longer asks you to write a file. one button keeps it to alles only, and a switch plus a list of the services alles found lets it manage others.

items.title: a new install opens setup
items.body: the first time you open alles it starts setup instead of release notes. the notes wait until you're set up.

items.title: backup targets say what they do
items.body: webdav and s3 backups that aren't set up show one line about what they're for and a set up button, instead of empty status rows.

items.title: busy instead of an error
items.body: a save that lands while alles is still starting up says it's busy and to try again, instead of a raw server error.

items.title: pick several from one list
items.body: activity's filters are one dropdown with checkmarks instead of a wall of chips. region, timezone and currency use the same dropdown as the rest of alles, and typing a few letters jumps to them.

items.title: nginx proxy manager sets itself up
items.body: one set up button checks the ports and starts it, waits while it gets ready, and makes its admin login for you. if a port is taken, it says which.

items.title: home knows the time, tasks act in place
items.body: dates read the same everywhere: today, tomorrow, sun, in 9 days, nov 12. home puts overdue tasks first, fades what's over and leads with tomorrow after 8 pm. check a task off or move it to tomorrow right from home or the task list, move every overdue task to today in one tap, and undo a delete.

items.title: bank sync you can find
items.body: finance shows bank connections on its overview and when you have no accounts yet. plaid comes first with its sign-up steps, and it now links over the tailnet.

items.title: gmail in one tap
items.body: pick gmail in mail. after a one-time google setup that alles walks you through, signing in is one button.

items.title: copy that works
items.body: copy buttons work when alles is opened over plain http on your network, and vault copy works in safari.

items.title: the whole world in settings
items.body: region, time zone and currency list every option with a search, and setup lets you fix a wrongly guessed region. passwords need 8 characters.

items.title: calmer details
items.body: fields show focus on their own edge, hover never looks like a pick, drawers slide shut, letters jump through dropdowns, and search suggests a fix for typos.

items.title: text aide on telegram
items.body: make a bot with @BotFather, paste its token and send it a message. aide answers there, and approvals still happen inside alles.

items.title: mail that shows up fast
items.body: a new device shows the mail alles saved last right away, and the inbox overview starts on unread with one button to summarize all of it.

items.title: one-click installs
items.body: settings and setup list node, pi, aide's browser and searxng with their real state and an install button. setup ends with what to connect next.

items.title: small tools in search
items.body: andromeda answers tips, percentages, bmi, loans, number bases, roman numerals, unix time, passwords, encoding, word counts and the moon without anything leaving your machine.

items.title: easier to find
items.body: files lists your docs folder read-only, habit icons come from an emoji search, and each book has one want / reading / read row.

items.title: habits with their own logs
items.body: pick from 55 habits like workout, reading, water or running. each one logs what fits it: sets and weights, pages, glasses, distance or minutes. custom habits stay a simple check.

items.title: easier to read
items.body: text is bigger everywhere, and bigger again on an ipad or a phone. font size in settings → general still works on top of it.

items.title: touch scrolling that stays put
items.body: a swipe scrolls the part of the screen you touch, not the whole page, and scrolling back while Aide is still replying holds still until you return to the end.

items.title: image results in even rows
items.body: andromeda's images keep their shape and line up in rows like google images, with the site and title under each one.

items.title: andromeda in settings
items.body: andromeda's search and answer settings moved into the one settings page, under apps. its answer model is the same one models shows, so changing either changes both.

items.title: effort that fits the model
items.body: Aide's effort menu shows only the levels your model takes. automatic lets the model decide.

items.title: alles in your language
items.body: the whole app, manual included, now comes in français, español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어 and العربية. pick one in settings → language & region.

items.title: totals in one currency
items.body: finance and subscriptions add everything up in your ledger currency. an amount with no rate is listed, not guessed, with a button to add the rate.

items.title: calendar files keep their times
items.body: a repeating event from another time zone now repeats in that zone, so it stays right when clocks change. importing the same file again replaces it instead of doubling it.

items.title: a tighter shell for Aide
items.body: Aide's shell, git and patch tools can only write inside the task's folder and its own temp folder, on macOS and linux.

items.title: commands in code
items.body: type / in Aide code to see every command. /context shows what fills pi's memory, /compact frees it up, /goal keeps pi working until something is done.

items.title: effort for pi
items.body: models that think get an effort control under the box. low answers fast; high thinks longer. a running chat switches right away.

items.title: hide keys from the model
items.body: wrap a key or password in two bars, like ||sk-…||, and pi uses it without ever seeing it.

items.title: text Aide from your phone
items.body: connect with Photon in settings and alles sets up iMessage and lets your number through. if Aide needs your ok, the text tells you.

items.title: buttons you can see
items.body: every button in settings has an outline now, so it doesn't read as plain text.
